title: Seagrove Beach "Sea Arbor" 2940 East County Highway 30A
h1: Seagrove Beach "Sea Arbor" 2940 East County Highway 30A
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front -Private heated pool *Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $30 per day-Complimentary beach setups provided each morning include 6 beach chairs and 3 umbrellas (service provided March 1-October 31 - Elevator - 6-passenger Low Speed Vehicle- 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Perched along the dazzling shores of the Emerald Coast, Sea Arbor graces 30A in the heart of stunning Seagrove Beach—a tranquil retreat where comfort seamlessly meets elegance. This luxurious 4,031-square-foot home boasts 4 beautifully appointed bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 16 guests. Designed for ultimate convenience and relaxation, the home features a private pool, an in-home elevator, and expansive outdoor spaces perfect for soaking in the coastal breeze. The highlight is the Gulf-front deck with breathtaking views overlooking sparkling turquoise waters, complemented by a private boardwalk that leads directly to the beach.The grand foyer, adorned by a dazzling chandelier and plush bench, welcomes guests into this 2-story home with refined comfort. The living area, bathed in natural light from expansive windows framing the vibrant coastal views, boasts tall ceilings and serene neutral tones, creating a peaceful atmosphere. Sink into the elegant furnishings for a family movie night or cocktails in front of the fireplace. Step outside to the covered patio, where inviting lounge chairs provide the perfect setting for serene sunrises and the alfresco dining table offers unforgettable sunset dinners. The gourmet kitchen boasts elegant cabinetry, sleek countertops, and high-end appliances surrounding a spacious island for easy meal prep. The adjacent dining table seats 8 with 4 additional seats at the breakfast bar. The first-floor guest bedroom features a king bed, spacious private bathroom, and stunning pool views framed by floor-to-ceiling curtains. A wine cooler is conveniently located near the patio, which features plush outdoor seating, a cozy fireplace, and wall-mounted TV, alongside the private pool. Stone steps lead to a stunning covered deck, offering breathtaking views of the Gulf, perfectly positioned beside a private boardwalk that provides direct beach access.A spiral staircase or in-home elevator leads upstairs to 3 spacious bedrooms and a laundry room. The primary bedroom boasts a king bed, walk-in closet, luxurious private bathroom,and balcony access. A guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and a private bathroom sits near the bunk room with 1 full-over-full and 2 twin-over-twin beds—ideal for adults and kids!Sea Arbor offers everything necessary for a memorable coastal getaway, including on-site parking, 4 adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. With direct beach access only steps away, the pristine sands of the Emerald Coast are always within reach. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 16):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 2 Queen Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full and 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video Seagrove Beach "Sea Arbor" 2940 East County Highway 30A Santa Rosa Beach, Florida Bedrooms 4 Beds 10 Sleeps 16 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gulf-front -Private heated pool *Pool heating available October 1-May 1 for $30 per day -Complimentary beach setups provided each morning include 6 beach chairs and 3 umbrellas (service provided March 1-October 31 - Elevator - 6-passenger Low Speed Vehicle - 4 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Perched along the dazzling shores of the Emerald Coast, Sea Arbor graces 30A in the heart of stunning Seagrove Beach—a tranquil retreat where comfort seamlessly meets elegance. This luxurious 4,031-square-foot home boasts 4 beautifully appointed bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 16 guests. Designed for ultimate convenience and relaxation, the home features a private pool, an in-home elevator, and expansive outdoor spaces perfect for soaking in the coastal breeze. The highlight is the Gulf-front deck with breathtaking views overlooking sparkling turquoise waters, complemented by a private boardwalk that leads directly to the beach. The grand foyer, adorned by a dazzling chandelier and plush bench, welcomes guests into this 2-story home with refined comfort. The living area, bathed in natural light from expansive windows framing the vibrant coastal views, boasts tall ceilings and serene neutral tones, creating a peaceful atmosphere. Sink into the elegant furnishings for a family movie night or cocktails in front of the fireplace. Step outside to the covered patio, where inviting lounge chairs provide the perfect setting for serene sunrises and the alfresco dining table offers unforgettable sunset dinners. The gourmet kitchen boasts elegant cabinetry, sleek countertops, and high-end appliances surrounding a spacious island for easy meal prep. The adjacent dining table seats 8 with 4 additional seats at the breakfast bar. The first-floor guest bedroom features a king bed, spacious private bathroom, and stunning pool views framed by floor-to-ceiling curtains. A wine cooler is conveniently located near the patio, which features plush outdoor seating, a cozy fireplace, and wall-mounted TV, alongside the private pool. Stone steps lead to a stunning covered deck, offering breathtaking views of the Gulf, perfectly positioned beside a private boardwalk that provides direct beach access. A spiral staircase or in-home elevator leads upstairs to 3 spacious bedrooms and a laundry room. The primary bedroom boasts a king bed, walk-in closet, luxurious private bathroom, and balcony access. A guest bedroom with 2 queen beds and a private bathroom sits near the bunk room with 1 full-over-full and 2 twin-over-twin beds—ideal for adults and kids! Sea Arbor offers everything necessary for a memorable coastal getaway, including on-site parking, 4 adult bikes, and a 6-passenger low-speed vehicle. With direct beach access only steps away, the pristine sands of the Emerald Coast are always within reach. Book today!
